newsitem.title: INDIA: India castor steady, little impact off export deals.
newsitem.headline: India castor steady, little impact off export deals.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery prices on Thursday were steady at 1,175/1,176 rupees per quintal with little impact from reports that exporters have finalised export deals at about 2,500 tonnes at $700 per tonne, dealers said.
"Sentiments however remained subdued on this news as earlier Indian exporters were offering at 715 dollars and now they have come down," one operator said.
Arrivals at the producing centres have been low due to the truckers strike but picked up on Thursday to 50,000/55,000 bags (75 kg each) of castorseed in Gujarat as the strike was called off.
Groundnut oil fell from 365/370 rupees to 358/359 rupees per 10 kg on demand resistance at higher levels while stockists were unloading stocks on expectation of fresh arrivals.
Imported palm oil also moved down from 297/298 rupees to 285/290 rupees per 10 kg as traders were expecting fresh inflow from Bombay ports to the market.
In the Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 540/545 rupees per 15 kg.
